“`

Supreme Beings, though disdainful of using their strength to bully the weak, will still not mind doing so if there is sufficient benefit.

Unless the ultimate weapon originated from another Supreme Being’s gift.

The Four Divine Kings are highly regarded in the Star Alliance, treated as the next ultimate existences to be nurtured, which is why they were bestowed with an ultimate weapon.

“But in this two-dimensional world, even if one refines an ultimate weapon, how much of its potential can actually be unearthed? When the time comes, a few of us old timers can join forces and simply take care of the Four Divine Kings first.”

The thin, small elder thought to himself.

...

In terms of sheer combat power, the Four Divine Kings were definitely stronger than him, and among all the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who had descended this time, the Four Divine Kings were most likely the strongest.

But the strongest does not mean invincible.

As long as they are not invincible, there is a possibility that the Four Divine Kings can be dealt with, suppressed.

At least in the eyes of the thin elder, the Four Divine Kings posed the greatest threat, and would certainly become his prime target when the time came.

It can be foreseen that at the summit of Heavenly Mountain, the Four Divine Kings will become the target of a collective assault.

If the Four Divine Kings are not taken care of first, a Tier 11 Perfect Legend like the thin, small elder would not dare to go all out.

“Enough.”

“This time it’s the perfect opportunity to discuss with those old friends how to deal with the Four Divine Kings.”

A smile appeared on the thin elder’s face, aside from those few other Tier 11 Perfect Legends at the same level, he had not taken any of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses seriously.

…

Outside the twelve Ancient Countries.

A Hidden World Force.

Within the two-dimensional world, the twelve Ancient Countries are only the largest forces.

Beyond the twelve Ancient Countries, there are many Hidden World Forces, which in terms of heritage, are no less than the Ancient Countries themselves, all established by a Witch Ancestor.

These forces have always lived secluded from the world, uninterested in the information and intelligence of the outside world.

Boom, boom, boom.

Just then.

Within the depths of this Hidden World Force.

A terrifying aura ascended, the massive power of Qi and blood trembling.

“Witch Ancestor.”

“I have finally become a Witch Ancestor.”

An excited middle-aged man walked out.

His name was Yan Fu, the strongest being of this Hidden World Force, who, after enduring strenuous cultivation, had finally stepped into the Witch Ancestor Realm.

In a two-dimensional world, for native beings to cultivate up to the level of Witch Ancestor is more difficult than ascending to heaven. In the past, whenever the Heavenly Gate opened, it was mostly contested by Witch Emperors.

As for the Witch Ancestors? As long as a Witch Ancestor could be born, it was almost certain they would enter the Heavenly Gate.

“It’s perfect timing that I entered the Witch Ancestor Realm just before the opening of the Heavenly Gate.”

“The task that my ancestors didn’t accomplish, it falls upon me to complete.”

Yan Fu was emotionally stirred.

For life in the two-dimensional world, entering the Heavenly Gate is the ultimate goal, the ultimate dream.

Even for a Witch Ancestor, entry into the Heavenly Gate is not guaranteed.

The Heavenly Gate opens every ten thousand years, but the lifespan of a Witch Ancestor is at most two to three thousand years. Therefore, to enter the Heavenly Gate, even Witch Ancestors need good fortune.

Yan Fu’s ancestral Witch Ancestor was not so lucky. He became a Witch Ancestor only eight hundred years after the Heavenly Gate last opened, directly extinguishing all hope of entering the Heavenly Gate.

…

Deep within the Cosmic Starry Skies.

A mysterious and ancient ‘scroll’ gradually unfurled.

Dozens of Supreme Beings observed solemnly, studying a piece of ‘White Paper’ in the distance.

In the two-dimensional world, there are still two months left before the opening of the Heavenly Gate, but in the Main Universe, it’s just a matter of a little over ten hours.

The flow of time in the two-dimensional world and the Main Universe is not consistent, with a ratio of one hundred to one.

“Heavenly Gate…”

“This opening of the Heavenly Gate may be our chance to glimpse the essence of this ‘White Paper’.”

“Indeed, if the Heavenly Gate is truly an internal connection of the ‘White Paper’ to the outside world, during its opening, we can completely take the chance to uncover some hidden aspects of the ‘White Paper’.”

“It may even help us in refining this ‘White Paper’.”

…

One after another, Supreme Beings await with grave anticipation.

Two years have passed, and they remained clueless about this ‘White Paper’, so they put all their hopes on the Heavenly Gate that was about to open.

“Feather Butterfly, is the Void Realm World ready?” Xia Qin Supreme Being looked toward the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being beside him.

“Don’t worry. Once the Heavenly Gate opens, if even a hint of breath leaks from the two-dimensional world within the White Paper, it will be captured by the Void Realm World. By that time, the similarity of the replicated two-dimensional world will be even higher.”

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being nodded, her evolution path as a Supreme Being originating from the ‘Void Realm World’, thus she naturally had mastery over it.

“That’s good.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said.

“I wonder what realm that youngster has cultivated to by now?” Xia Qin Supreme Being suddenly thought.

The ‘youngster’ he mentioned was, of course, Lin Yuan.

Ever since learning two hundred years ago that Lin Yuan was already the terrifying Nineteenth Realm Witch Ancestor, Xia Qin Supreme Being had pinned all his hopes for the evolution of human civilization from the two-dimensional world on him.

It couldn’t be helped.

Two hundred years ago, aside from Lin Yuan, the strongest evolver in human civilization was only at the Fourteenth Realm.

As Xia Qin Supreme Being’s thoughts were turning.

A voice suddenly came through.

“Xia Qin, what have you decided?” A Supreme Being from the Star Alliance looked over, transmitting his words secretly.

He still did not want to give up on the marvels collected by the human civilization evolvers; as long as they are brought out through the Four Divine Kings, the Star Alliance could gain greatly from it.

Since the Star Alliance was not in a hostile relationship with human civilization, this Supreme Being, who achieved his Ultimate Being status through a unique life form, wasn’t too concerned about human civilization profiting in the end.
